Remark
[$L^p$ version of the Lebesgue point theorem] ↗ thm:lebesgue-differentiation-theorem 1. appE:E.4-rem-1\group Measure Theory

If $f\in L^p_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb R^n)$ for $1\leq p<\infty $, then for a.e. $x_0\in \mathbb R^n$, \[ \fint _{B(x_0,r)}|f(x)-f(x_0)|^p\, dx\to 0 \qquad (r\to 0). \]
